elena-finance: FYI found a negative hosted usage line on customer Zenith's March invoice for -$62,400. Looks like it came from the 'spring_trial_promo' backfill. Need guidance for month-end R-rec. cc @nia-accounting
raj-ops: Backfill job backfill-20260322-b9 ran 2026-03-22; it created negative invoice lines for usage in Jan-Mar rather than credit memos. I can export the invoice lineage.
nia-accounting: If we can tie credit amounts to original recognition months, reverse revenue in those periods (contra revenue GL). If we cannot map, book as current-period revenue adjustment and disclose. Approval needed for adjustments > $25k.
elena-finance: This one is just over the threshold. I'll prepare tie-out CSV and request CFO sign-off. Raj please attach invoice IDs and runbook.
cfo-bot: Reminder: adjustments > $25,000 require email approval to finance-cfo with supporting tie-out and explanation for disclosure pack.
